edition_exception.meaning: Current per rated ampere-hour capacity and power per rated watt-hour capacity.

case.standing: DMTF public-rackmount1 synthetic example at pinned 2025.2 release. Documents are examples, not installed observations.
case.reading: The BMC is located in and manages chassis 1U, through separate links. The sensor record supplies the example reading 43 Cel, refers to memory and links DIMM2 as the related resource. This does not identify a separately serialized physical probe.
case.deployment_evidence_needed: Service and equipment inventory with dated identifiers, topology and sensor-to-component attribution.

holds.RF-Q1: All named families indexed; detailed semantics selectively traced. Unvisited clauses, every vendor extension, older revisions and untraced member meanings remain open.
holds.RF-Q2: DSP2046 is informational; supported protocol or conformance claims require a separate specification, service/profile or implementation. Registered CIM artifact 90 is a separate donor.
holds.RF-Q3: Publisher mockups illustrate records. Actual installations, real readings, physical probe identity, exercised actions and deployed release require independent instance evidence.
